title: Critique: consciousness always goes with self-consciousness

statements.text: Limanowski and Friston argue from active inference that a self-evidencing model already separates self from non-self, so that consciousness always goes together with basic self-consciousness. This seems to contradict the claim that there can be phenomenal world-models without phenomenal self-models, which they leave to be clarified.

sources.quote: Our argument is further that consciousness will always go hand-in-hand with self-consciousness.
this may seem to contradict SMT’s claim that there can be phenomenal world-models without phenomenal self-models
